english.title: With intent to deceive alter evidence kept for the purposes of regulation 9(3)(b)
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent to deceive, altered evidence kept for the purposes of regulation 9(3)(b) of the Weights and Measures (Packaged Goods) Regulations 2006 by **(..SPECIFY ALTERATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 13(4)(b) and 18(2) of the Weights and Measures (Packaged Goods) Regulations 2006.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Regulation 10(4) provides that proceedings for an offence under these Regulations, other than an offence under regulation 16, shall not be instituted after the expiration of the period of twelve months beginning with the date when the offence was committed.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, with intent to deceive, altered evidence kept for the purposes of regulation 9(3)(b) of the Weights and Measures (Packaged Goods) Regulations 2006 by **(..SPECIFY ALTERATION..).

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months
